professional_summary.content: Sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate her developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, sensory processing, and adaptive behavior domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging strength, such as social engagement and learning potential, and areas requiring targeted intervention, including fine motor coordination, attention, focus, communication skills, and behavioral regulation. These deficits impact her functional performance and daily activities, particularly in structured tasks and social interactions. Based on the assessment findings, occupational therapy services are recommended to address her needs and support optimal developmental progression. A collaborative, family-centered approach involving occupational therapy, speech therapy, and behavioral intervention services will be beneficial in facilitating comprehensive developmental support. Regular monitoring and reassessment will be important to track progress and adjust intervention strategies as needed to promote functional independence and developmental success. Family involvement and education are crucial to implementing strategies consistently across home and community settings. Overall, Sabrina is expected to make significant gains with a consistent, interdisciplinary intervention approach, enhancing her developmental trajectory and quality of life.
